proof_in_the_paper: The HAADF-STEM results show an ultrafine one-dimensional (1D) crystalline configuration with rich surface defects, concave cavity sites and steps, as highlighted by white arrows in Fig. 2a. The HAADF-STEM image shows that the (111) spacing is 0.225 nm (Fig. 2a), ~2.2% smaller than that of crystalline Pt (0.230 nm).
